title: Strong Spatial Influence on Colonization Rates in a Pioneer Zooplankton Metacommunity (Frisch and others, 2012)

source.license: CC BY (Creative Commons Attribution License, as stated in the PDF and on the PLoS ONE page)

summary: Measures how quickly zooplankton colonised 96 experimental ponds dug in 2004-2005 on the Caracoles estate in Doñana. The searches lane uses it to show that some oval "circles" in satellite photos are research ponds.
